name: bisect
title: Rootfinding Through Bisection or Secant Rule
description: Finding roots of univariate functions in bounded intervals.
usage: bisect(fun, a, b, maxiter = 500, tol = NA, ...)
py: np.array([bisect(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1, 2)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])

name: secant
title: Rootfinding Through Bisection or Secant Rule
description: Secant search for a zero of a univariate function.
usage: secant(fun, a, b, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-08, ...)
py: np.array([secant(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1, 2)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])

name: regulaFalsi
title: Rootfinding Through Bisection or Secant Rule
description: Regula falsi with the Illinois rule on a bracketed interval.
usage: regulaFalsi(fun, a, b, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-08, ...)
py: np.array([regulaFalsi(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1, 2)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])

name: ridders
title: Ridders' Root Finding Method
description: Ridders' method for a root in an interval where the function changes sign.
usage: ridders(fun, a, b, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-12, ...)
py: np.array([ridders(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1, 2)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])

name: brentDekker
title: Brent-Dekker Root Finding Algorithm
description: Find a root by bisection, the secant method, and quadratic interpolation.
usage: brentDekker(fun, a, b, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-12, ...)
py: np.array([brentDekker(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1, 2)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])

name: brent
title: Brent-Dekker Root Finding Algorithm
description: Alias of brentDekker.
usage: brent(fun, a, b, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-12, ...)
py: np.array([brent(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1, 2)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])

name: muller
title: Muller's Method
description: Root finding by a parabola through three points.
usage: muller(f, p0, p1, p2 = NULL, maxiter = 100, tol = 1e-10)
py: np.array([muller(lambda x: x*x - 2, 0, 2)[k] for k in ('root', 'fval')])
args: Third start. The midpoint when omitted.

name: fzero
title: Root Finding Algorithm
description: Find a root of a continuous function of one variable.
usage: fzero(fun, x, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-12, ...)
py: np.array([fzero(lambda x: x*x - 2, [1, 2])[k] for k in ('x', 'fval')])

name: newton
title: Rootfinding through Newton-Raphson or Secant.
description: Alias of newtonRaphson.
usage: newton(fun, x0, dfun = NULL, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-08, ...)
py: np.array([newton(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])
args: Derivative. A central difference when omitted.

name: newtonRaphson
title: Rootfinding through Newton-Raphson or Secant.
description: Newton's method for a univariate root, with a central difference when the derivative is omitted.
usage: newtonRaphson(fun, x0, dfun = NULL, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-08, ...)
py: np.array([newtonRaphson(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])
args: Derivative. A central difference when omitted.

name: halley
title: Halley's Root Finding Mathod
description: Finding roots of univariate functions using Halley's method.
usage: halley(fun, x0, maxiter = 500, tol = 1e-08, ...)
py: np.array([halley(lambda x: x*x - 2, 1)[k] for k in ('root', 'f.root')])

name: newtonHorner
title: Newton's Root Finding Method for Polynomials.
description: Newton's method for a polynomial, with Horner evaluation and deflation.
usage: newtonHorner(p, x0, maxiter = 50, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5)

name: fminbnd
title: Finding Function Minimum
description: Find the minimum of a single-variable function on a fixed interval.
usage: fminbnd(f, a, b, maxiter = 1000, maximum = FALSE, tol = 1e-07, rel.tol = tol, abs.tol = 1e-15, ...)
args: Search for a maximum when true.

name: fibsearch
title: Fibonacci Search
description: Fibonacci search for a univariate minimum on a bounded interval.
usage: fibsearch(f, a, b, ..., endp = FALSE, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(1/2))

name: shubert
title: Shubert-Piyavskii Method
description: Shubert-Piyavskii univariate maximization on a bounded interval.
usage: shubert(f, a, b, L, crit = 1e-04, nmax = 1000)
case: maximum of -(x - 0.2)^2 on [0, 1] with Lipschitz constant 2

name: nelder_mead
title: Nelder-Mead Function Minimization Method
description: Derivative-free Nelder-Mead minimization.
usage: nelder_mead(fn, x0, ..., adapt = TRUE, tol = 1e-08, maxfeval = 5000, step = rep(1, length(x0)))

name: anms
title: Adaptive Nelder-Mead Minimization
description: Adaptive Nelder-Mead minimization.
usage: anms(fn, x0, ..., tol = 1e-10, maxfeval = NULL)

name: hooke_jeeves
title: Hooke-Jeeves Function Minimization Method
description: Derivative-free Hooke-Jeeves minimization, with optional box constraints.
usage: hooke_jeeves(x0, fn, ..., lb = NULL, ub = NULL, tol = 1e-08, maxfeval = 10000, target = Inf, info = FALSE)

name: fminsearch
title: Derivative-free Nonlinear Function Minimization
description: Derivative-free minimization by Nelder-Mead or Hooke-Jeeves.
usage: fminsearch(fn, x0, ..., lower = NULL, upper = NULL, method = c("Nelder-Mead", "Hooke-Jeeves"), minimize = TRUE, maxiter = 1000, tol = 1e-08)

name: softline
title: Soft (Inexact) Line Search
description: Fletcher's inexact line search.
usage: softline(x0, d0, f, g = NULL)
args: Gradient. A central difference when omitted.

name: steep_descent
title: Steepest Descent Minimization
description: Function minimization by steepest descent.
usage: steep_descent(x0, f, g = NULL, info = FALSE, maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(1/2))
args: Gradient. A central difference when omitted.

name: fletcher_powell
title: Fletcher-Powell Conjugate Gradient Minimization
description: Davidon-Fletcher-Powell quasi-Newton minimization.
usage: fletcher_powell(x0, f, g = NULL, maxiter = 1000, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(2/3))
args: Gradient. A central difference when omitted.

name: fminunc
title: Minimize Unconstrained Multivariable Function
description: Unconstrained minimization by a variable-metric update.
usage: fminunc(x0, fn, gr = NULL, ..., tol = 1e-08, maxiter = 0, maxfeval = 0)
args: Gradient. A central difference when omitted.

name: broyden
title: Broyden's Method
description: Broyden's method for n nonlinear equations in n variables.
usage: broyden(Ffun, x0, J0 = NULL, ..., maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(1/2))
r: with(broyden(function(x) x - c(1, 2), c(0, 0)), c(zero, fnorm))
py: np.concatenate([np.ravel(broyden(lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]), [0, 0])['zero']), [broyden(lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]), [0, 0])['fnorm']]])
args: Jacobian at the start. Numerical when omitted.

name: gaussNewton
title: Gauss-Newton Function Minimization
description: Gauss-Newton minimization of a sum of squares.
usage: gaussNewton(x0, Ffun, Jfun = NULL, maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(1/2), ...)
r: with(gaussNewton(c(0, 0), function(x) x - c(1, 2)), c(xs, fs))
py: np.concatenate([np.ravel(gaussNewton(np.array([0.0, 0.0]), lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]))['xs']), [gaussNewton(np.array([0.0, 0.0]), lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]))['fs']]])

name: fsolve
title: Solve System of Nonlinear Equations
description: Solve a square system with Broyden, or a rectangular system with Gauss-Newton.
usage: fsolve(f, x0, J = NULL, maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(0.5), ...)
r: with(fsolve(function(x) x - c(1, 2), c(0, 0)), c(x, fval))
py: np.concatenate([np.ravel(fsolve(lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]), [0, 0])['x']), np.ravel(fsolve(lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]), [0, 0])['fval'])])

name: fzsolve
title: Complex Root Finding
description: Find a root of a complex function by splitting it into a real square system.
usage: fzsolve(fz, z0)

name: lsqnonlin
title: Nonlinear Least-Squares Fitting
description: Levenberg-Marquardt nonlinear least squares.
usage: lsqnonlin(fun, x0, options = list(), ...)
r: with(lsqnonlin(function(x) x - c(1, 2), c(0, 0)), c(x, ssq))
py: np.concatenate([np.ravel(lsqnonlin(lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]), [0, 0])['x']), [lsqnonlin(lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]), [0, 0])['ssq']]])

name: lsqcurvefit
title: Nonlinear Least-Squares Fitting
description: Fit a curve by nonlinear least squares.
usage: lsqcurvefit(fun, p0, xdata, ydata)
r: with(lsqcurvefit(function(p, x) p[1] * exp(-p[2] * x), c(1, 1), c(0, 1), c(1, 0.3)), c(x, ssq))
py: np.concatenate([np.ravel(lsqcurvefit(lambda p, x: p[0] * np.exp(-p[1] * np.asarray(x, float)), [1, 1], [0, 1], [1, 0.3])['x']), [lsqcurvefit(lambda p, x: p[0] * np.exp(-p[1] * np.asarray(x, float)), [1, 1], [0, 1], [1, 0.3])['ssq']]])

name: lsqnonneg
title: Nonlinear Least-Squares Fitting
description: Nonnegative linear least squares.
usage: lsqnonneg(C, d)
case: nonnegative least squares of the identity against (1, 2)

name: lsqlin
title: Linear Least-Squares Fitting
description: Linear least squares, with optional equality constraints.
usage: lsqlin(A, b, C, d, tol = 1e-13)
case: least squares of the identity against (3, 4)

name: linprog
title: Linear Programming Solver
description: Linear programming with inequality and equality constraints and bounds.
usage: linprog(cc, A = NULL, b = NULL, Aeq = NULL, beq = NULL, lb = NULL, ub = NULL, x0 = NULL, I0 = NULL, bigM = 100, maxiter = 20, maximize = FALSE)
case: minimize x subject to x <= 2 and -x <= 0
r: with(linprog(1, matrix(c(1, -1), ncol = 1), c(2, 0)), c(x, fval))

name: qpspecial
title: Special Quadratic Programming Solver
description: Smallest vector in the convex hull of the columns of G.
usage: qpspecial(G, x, maxit = 100)
case: convex hull of the columns of the 2 by 2 identity
args: Matrix whose columns form the convex hull.

name: qpsolve
title: Special Quadratic Programming Solver
description: Minimize 0.5 x'x - d'x subject to the linear constraints stored in the columns of A.
usage: qpsolve(d, A, b, meq = 0, tol = 1e-07)

name: quadprog
title: Quadratic Programming
description: Solves quadratic programming problems with linear and box constraints.
usage: quadprog(C, d, A = NULL, b = NULL, Aeq = NULL, beq = NULL, lb = NULL, ub = NULL)
case: stops because the suggested package is not installed
raises: quadprog needed for this function to work. Please install it.
r_value: quadprog needed for this function to work. Please install it.
py_value: quadprog needed for this function to work. Please install it.

name: lsqlincon
title: Linear Least-Squares Fitting with linear constraints
description: Solves linearly constrained linear least-squares problems.
usage: lsqlincon(C, d, A = NULL, b = NULL, Aeq = NULL, beq = NULL, lb = NULL, ub = NULL)
case: stops because the suggested package is not installed
raises: quadprog needed for this function to work. Please install it.
r_value: quadprog needed for this function to work. Please install it.
py_value: quadprog needed for this function to work. Please install it.

name: fmincon
title: Minimize Nonlinear Constrained Multivariable Function.
description: Find a minimum of a multivariable function with nonlinear constraints.
usage: fmincon(x0, fn, gr = NULL, ..., method = "SQP", A = NULL, b = NULL, Aeq = NULL, beq = NULL, lb = NULL, ub = NULL, hin = NULL, heq = NULL, tol = 1e-06, maxfeval = 10000, maxiter = 5000)
case: SQP stops because NlcOptim is not installed
